note: CLEAN START (captain, 2026-10-02): the demo household's recorded arrangements are REMOVED. `loved_ones` is EMPTY — a loved one whose record carries no case renders the honest 'not connected' state, which is now the state every loved one starts in.

WHAT THIS IS: the office's recorded arrangement for each loved one — the five moments the family portal's chain names (arrangement · viewing · funeral · burial · papers), each with the recorded instant or day, the place and the state. The staff case service (case-events-v1) has no family-facing read, so this is a provisional family fixture exactly like lib/fixtures/family/snapshot.json; live mode is not claimed and lib/api-client/family.ts::getFamilyCase is the only reader.

THE HOUSEHOLD SHAPE (captain, 2026-09-30): one account manages MANY loved ones, so `loved_ones[]` carries one recorded arrangement per person, keyed by the same `id` as snapshot.json and workspace.json.

NEVER INVENTED: no amount, no family-facing case number and no coordinator name appears — the office's case numbering and assignment are internal. A step the record does not carry is marked not_recorded and the page says so in a few words rather than guessing a time.
DEMO DATA ONLY: the family API has no live branch; a loved one whose record carries no case renders the honest 'not connected' state instead of a guessed schedule.
